incidents.stage: metadata preflight before any feature or target calculation
incidents.detail: An initial literal substring check compared deposited RNA-letter full strings against DNA-letter CDS strings. All 37 failed that unnormalized check despite matching lengths. The check was corrected to apply the already authorized T-to-U conversion to both strings.
incidents.resolution: Check normalized sequence identity only; retain original strings and their separate hashes.

incidents.stage: synthetic interface tests before real folding or target access
incidents.detail: Initial suite: 43 passed, one failed because exp_param.pf_scale has no setter in ViennaRNA 2.7.2. A 12-base synthetic interface probe confirmed that exp_params_rescale(mfe) itself updates the scale. The unsupported setter was removed before any real computation.
incidents.resolution: Exactly one supported MFE-based rescaling API call, with its effective scale recorded. No alternate parameter set or structural predictor was tried.

prior_exposures_preserved: Earlier solution-row and published aggregate-text exposures remain in the original report and proposal review. They are not relabelled untouched. No new cellular outcome cell has been inspected in this implementation task.
